doc.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Joe Williams and Hamilton College
summary: Joe loves Hamilton and blocks out time for it and the Kennedy Honors; Levy says he will visit next time.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Yes, he was. And we just did Clark Terry.

Yeah, Clark Terry, yeah. And he told me, “leave that time open — I’m going there — they’re going to give a doctorate to George” or, “they’re going to give a doctorate to Clark.” And he’s been trying to get me to come with him. He wanted me to come this last time.
You should come, it’s nice there.
Oh, I don’t want to travel.
Oh, it’s right up the Thruway from you, you know.
Well we’ll get you up there.

But anyway, sooner or later I’ll go with him. Because there’s two things that he has blocked out every year, and that’s the Kennedy Center and the Kennedy Honors in December and your school, that period of time — those two things.
“I don’t work during that period” he says. And that’s the way it goes, yeah.
